title: Niagara Fish Assassins - Sports Fishing in Ontario
specs: Fish species include chinook salmon, coho salmon, rainbow trout, brown trout, lake trout, northern pike, smallmouth bass, largemouth bass, walleye, muskellunge, carp
Fishing areas include Niagara Bar, Lower Niagara River, and Lake Ontario south shore

services.name: salmon fishing
services.desc: The vessel is a brand new 21-foot Alumacraft Competitor equipped with state-of-the-art fishing gear, safety features and an impressive 150 horsepower Mercury tiller. She’s a spacious vessel, with enough room for three anglers to fish in comfort. We have all the necessary safety and navigation gear to make sure it’s convenient for long trips. Bottom bouncing fresh eggs and egg imitations or live bait on light tackle is an extremely effective technique providing plenty of hits and hookups. The Niagara is known as one of the best steelhead rivers in the world! These chrome leapers are one of the most exciting fish to catch on light tackle. Trophy Lake Trout and Brown Trout are also plentiful.

quotes.author: Adrian Faria
quotes.text: Had a fantastic time this past Canada day (July 1, 2021), launching from Bluffer's Park Marina. Our captain Devin was a champ, we ended up catching 11 chinooks (20lb plus range), 2 cohos, and a rainbow. Was not expecting there to be that much action, everyone had a killer time. Devin was also a great help to us inexperienced fishermen, shared a lot of insight, and was overall a super chill guy. I am definitely looking to go out again with Niagara Fish Assassins, maybe make it a Canada day tradition.

quotes.author: Shelley McLean
quotes.text: I went fishing with Phillip Spencer Friday July 2nd on Captain Marks boat. I haven't fished in over 30 years and I wanted to take the time to thank Captain Mark for an unforgettable experience. I ended up losing my phone in lake Ontario as we were hauling our fish off the boat. it truly was an unforgettable moment. thank you Captain Mark you were a fantastic guide and thank you I have been telling everyone I know about niagara fish assassins....

quotes.author: Jeremy Niedorezow
quotes.text: It was a great experience, Captain Mark has a great team on his boats, we were set up with Captain Conner, he did not take long to get us on fish, very friendly and informative, he made our trip very enjoyable! I look forward to my next trip, and definitely be happy with Captain Conner taking us out on the water again!

quotes.author: Brock Thompson
quotes.text: Went out with Devin and Connor on Saturday afternoon (06/26/21) and had an absolute blast! These 2 guys were super professional and put us on the meat the whole time. Super nice guys and super easy to get along with. We filled the boat and they made it so easy for us to enjoy the experience!!! 10/10 would recommend.

quotes.author: Greg Kinnear
quotes.text: Friday July 10th Captain Bob put us on fish right away, by 8am the 6 of us had each caught a salmon. The equipment is top notch. Bob even cleaned the fish for us. This was my 4 trip with Niagara fish assassins. I highly recommend at this place and Captain Bob if your lucky enough to get him at the helm!

quotes.author: Jenn N
quotes.text: We had an awesome time fishing this Father’s Day with Bob at Fish Assassins! The weather was perfect & the fish were biting. We caught 8 nice sized fish which Bob cleaned up for us to take home. We will be returning for another exciting day out on the water with these great guys!
